verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is a virtual mailbox and mail-scanning service, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers is outside its product role. Its AI summaries and labeling and its general API integrations do not make it an MCP client, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
